text:
Avery (marketing): we just locked the date for the micro-workshop (next Tues). need a tight playbook: reg page, zoom config, recording + captions, and post-event lead routing into hubspot. 48h turnaround.
Sam (ops): +1 on timeline. who owns the reg page? i can spin up a simple page but need the copy and form fields.
Priya (growth): I can write lean copy. primary goal: signups -> watch-on-demand. secondary: qualify for call. keep the form minimal (email, company, job function, consent checkbox).
Ben (content): suggest we add an optional field: "what's your biggest latency/cost pain?" for segmentation. short placeholder text.
Lia (events): Zoom settings: record to cloud, record separate audio for each participant, enable auto-transcribe, and add SRT export. also make sure "join before host" is off. can someone confirm host licensing?
Sam (ops): host is under company.zoom@redwood.com (licensed). i'll schedule and set cloud recording. zoom settings i'll use: 
```
Record on the cloud: enabled
Record active speaker with shared screen: enabled
Audio: separate files (one per participant)
Auto-transcription: enabled (generate SRT)
Join before host: disabled
Waiting room: enabled for external guests
```
Priya (growth): great. for reg page CTA text iteration: option A: "Reserve your spot — learn low-latency serving patterns" option B: "Join our hands-on micro-workshop: cut token costs in half" lean test after send.
Avery (marketing): capture utm params on the page and include hidden fields: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign. send to hubspot as contact properties.
Sam (ops): Zap plan: new submission -> filter (consent = yes) -> create/update contact in HubSpot -> add contact to list "MW-registrants-MAR" -> send welcome email via Customer.io. quick pseudo-config: 
```
Trigger: New form submission (Webflow)
Filter: consent == true
Action 1: HubSpot Create/Update Contact (map: email, company, job_function, question_field)
Action 2: Add to list: MW-registrants-MAR
Action 3: Post to #marketing-notify with payload (email, name, utm_campaign)
```
Ben (content): welcome email draft: "Thanks for signing up — your spot is reserved. Add this to your calendar + here’s a short pre-read." keep subject 6-8 words. I'll post copy in the doc.
Lia (events): post-event: recording -> trim to 3 clips (teaser 60s, highlights 3-4m, full session). Edit owner: @Ben for teaser + highlights, @EditBot for full raw trim and SRT merge. delivery SLA: 48h for teaser, 72h for highlights, 5 days for full edited with chapter markers.
EditBot: received. queuing job. ETA for raw export: 2h after meeting ends.
Priya (growth): leads routing after recording: attendees get "attended" property; registrants who didn't attend -> watch-on-demand flow with 1-day followup + nurture over 2 weeks. We'll use these segments: attendees, no-show but watched replay, registered-no-action.
Avery (marketing): tagging conventions: source="micro-workshop-mar", medium=web, campaign=mw-march. use contact property "redwood_event_source". Also populate "engagement_channel" = webinar/replay/email.
Sam (ops): checklist for host on the day:
- confirm cloud recording enabled
- join 15m early for sound check
- record a 5s slate at start ("Redwood Inference micro-workshop — March")
- start recording manually and double-check cloud shows "recording"
- if any shared screens, use presenter view
Priya (growth): consent language for reg page: "By registering you consent to receive event-related communications from Redwood Inference. You can unsubscribe any time." must link privacy policy.
Ben (content): also add CTA in post-event email: "Tell us if you'd like a follow-up consult" -> map to contact property followup_interest.
Lia (events): who publishes the recording to the knowledge base and where do we store SRT/source files? Sam?
Sam (ops): upload raw + SRT to: gs://redwood-events/mw-2026-mar/raw/ and edited to gs://redwood-events/mw-2026-mar/edited/. I'll share ACLs with Ben & Priya.
Avery (marketing): analytics: add tracking on watch page to fire event "mw_replay_view" with user email if known. also set up a short GA goal to count conversions from the replay page.
Priya (growth): A/B test CTA subject lines for reminder emails. i'll run cohort split 50/50 on registrant list. Ben will keep copy tight.
Ben (content): I'll upload the teaser + subject line variants to the content folder and leave comments.
Avery (marketing): final owners: reg page & UTM - Priya; Zoom setup & recording - Sam; edit owners - Ben & EditBot; Zap/hubspot mapping - Sam + Priya; welcome + nurture copy - Ben + Priya; analytics - Avery.
Lia (events): i'll send the event run-of-show tomorrow morning. any blockers?
Priya (growth): none from me. prepping copy now.
Ben (content): no blockers. will post draft in 2h. :thumbsup:
Sam (ops): i'll provision the meeting and post the invite. posting here when done.
Avery (marketing): perfect — thanks all. tagging follow ups: @Sam confirm upload ACLs, @Ben deliver teaser by EOD, @Priya reg page live 24h before event. :rocket:
